flags.message: CourtListener MCP returned HTTP 429 (300/hour shared rate limit) on three of five calls, including the Sixth Circuit docket entries and the linked cert docket No. 26-391. Per the prompt I proceeded on the provisioned inputs and the statpack without waiting; no other retrieval path was used. The forecast is degraded only in that the Sixth Circuit opinion text and the petition docket state were not confirmed independently.

The application asks the Court, in the alternative, to construe the stay application as a petition for certiorari and set the case for argument, and a cert petition (No. 26-391) is linked. If the Court defers the application pending the petition, or disposes of it in an order that also acts on No. 26-391, the disposing entry may not match the interim resolver's four labels cleanly. Forecast assumes a plain denial entry.
